name: Binary Sign (BitNet)
tagline: Weights binarized to {-1,+1} via sign with absmean per-tensor scale; activations absmax-quantized to int8 with STE.
diff_from_baseline: Wang et al., BitNet 2023. The original 1-bit linear layer: sign() weights with absmean scale plus int8 absmax activations and straight-through gradients.

name: INT2 Uniform
tagline: Weights quantized to four uniform levels {-1, -1/3, +1/3, +1} via absmean scaling and STE rounding; int8 absmax activations.
diff_from_baseline: 2-bit uniform-grid quantization with absmean scale — slightly more expressive than ternary while remaining very low-bit. Same STE / int8 activation recipe as BitNet.

name: Ternary 1.58-bit
tagline: Ternary {-1,0,+1} weight quantization via absmean clip-and-round (log₂3 ≈ 1.58 bits) with int8 activations.
diff_from_baseline: Ma et al., The Era of 1-bit LLMs (BitNet b1.58, 2024). Ternary weights with absmean-clip-round; the zero level lets the layer effectively gate connections.
